    Use the AI skill

    Custom Toolbar includes an extend-custom-toolbar skill for AI coding agents. The skill guides the agent through Unity version selection, file placement, assembly references, module implementation, and validation.

    Skill location

    The skill is included in the installed package at:

    Packages/com.nkstudio.custom-toolbar/Skills/extend-custom-toolbar/SKILL.md

    The complete extend-custom-toolbar folder contains the main instructions and separate implementation references for supported Unity versions.

    What the skill does

    The skill instructs the agent to:

    • read ProjectSettings/ProjectVersion.txt as the source of truth for the Unity Editor version;
    • use IToolbarModule and ILegacyToolbarModule on Unity 2022.3 through 6000.2;
    • use Unity's official MainToolbarElement API on Unity 6000.3 or newer;
    • create project-specific modules under Assets/Editor/ToolbarModules instead of editing the installed package;
    • add an Editor-only assembly reference when required;
    • check module IDs, refresh paths, lifecycle subscriptions, and compilation.

    Ask an agent to use the skill

    Provide the skill path explicitly in your request:

    Read Packages/com.nkstudio.custom-toolbar/Skills/extend-custom-toolbar/SKILL.md
and add a new Custom Toolbar module to this project.

    Include the desired control type, toolbar position, action, and Play Mode behavior in the request when known.

    Automatic skill discovery

    If the coding agent supports automatic skill discovery, install or copy the entire extend-custom-toolbar folder into that agent's skills directory. Keep the referenced files together with SKILL.md; the skill selects one of them after checking the project's Unity version.

    For the underlying module APIs and manual examples, see Create a custom module.
